title: Triceratops, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Imagine witnessing the moment when one of the swiftest predators of the Cretaceous period breaks free from its prehistoric egg. The coin captures this scene using lenticular technology, creating a striking three-dimensional sense of depth and motion. It is a carefully crafted design that brings together the world of prehistory and contemporary minting artistry.
